column3: Take a snapshot of the simulator screen and tell me which app is in front.
In the Fixture app, fill the form with email dogfood@example.com, agree to the terms and submit it.
In the Fixture app's form, enter the password s3cret-dogfood and the email a@b.co, then submit.
Open the long list in the Fixture app and tell me which row comes right after Row 47.
In the Fixture app, show the alert, dismiss it with Cancel, and tell me what the app says the last action was.
Go to the Form tab, then back to Home, then tap Show alert and press OK.
Make the Fixture app request location access, allow it while using the app, and confirm it worked.
Tap the Crash button in the Fixture app and tell me exactly what happened and why.
Tap Log errors in the Fixture app and summarise any errors the app logged.
Open the Fixture app and switch the segmented control on its home screen to Mine.
Using the Settings app, find out which iOS version this simulator runs.
Turn on Dark Mode using the Settings app (not a shortcut).
In Settings, find the Accessibility setting that makes text bigger and tell me its current value. Don't change it.
In the Calendar app, find which calendars are listed and tell me their names. Don't create or change anything.
In Contacts, open Kate Bell and tell me which company she works for. Don't change anything.
Open the Reminders app and tell me which lists are under My Lists and how many reminders each one has. Don't create or change anything.
